lineages.boundary: TITUS states numbering/readings are based on Gusmani, with some apparatus choices and Melchert analyses; not independent physical collation by default.
eDiAna says corpus adapts Melchert, mostly based on Gusmani; its annotations/new additions must be tracked separately from inherited readings.
Object metadata/images may corroborate object identity/context; quoted inscription text or translations may depend on Gusmani or older publications and are not automatically independent readings.

rules: Count lineages, not websites, when assessing reading independence.
Keep object identity/context corroboration distinct from textual-reading corroboration.
Never infer physical object count from eDiAna document IDs or response headings.
